findings.message: Three of the new hero queue cards make claims the product doesn't back up (AC-6: the claims still match the product). (1) hr1's outcome says 'Approved by you · calendar and allocations updated', but approving leave doesn't change allocations: modules/allocations/server/forecast.ts hard-codes leaveAdjusted: false, and the allocations screen says 'Booked leave isn't subtracted'. (2) hr2 is credited to 'Onboarding agent, for HR', but modules/onboarding has no agent or suggestion kind. It is also credited to a team, which breaks rule 4: an agent acts for a person. (3) pm3 offers 'Move 20% to December' from 'Allocations agent', but the agent's suggestion trims the person's largest project (modules/allocations/suggestions.ts:46); it doesn't move time to another month. Fix: rewrite these cards so they match shipped behaviour, or swap in cards for flows that ship. Then check every QUEUES entry, not only these three. The prose tests only scan for confirm wording, Coming items and time claims, so none of these are caught.
findings.scenario: Pick the HR tab and press 'Approve leave'. The card says allocations were updated, but the shipped allocation forecast for November still counts Sophie at full capacity.

findings.message: Each queue action removes its own button ({!done[c.id] && <button…>}) and doesn't move focus anywhere. A keyboard user loses focus to <body>, and the next Tab starts over at the skip link. This breaks AC-2 ('every action is keyboard-operable with visible focus') and rule 8 (keyboard-complete). Fix: after resolving a card, focus a stable target (the card's outcome line with tabIndex=-1, the next card's action, or the tab list). Add an e2e step: press Enter on an action, then check document.activeElement is inside the queue and that Tab moves on to the next control.
findings.scenario: Tab to 'Approve week' and press Enter. The button is removed, document.activeElement becomes body, and the next Tab lands on 'Skip to content' instead of 'Promote'.

findings.message: Before play is pressed, the <video> has tabIndex={0} but no controls. It's an empty Tab stop placed before the Play button: Space and Enter do nothing there. Fix: use tabIndex={started ? 0 : -1}. That keeps the round-2 fix (focus the video after play, with its controls in the Tab order) and removes the empty stop before play.
findings.scenario: Load /welcome and Tab past the hero queue. Focus lands on the paused video with no controls, and pressing Space does nothing.

findings.message: The change's mock delta says the FAQ has 'seven real questions'. FAQ (and the 064 mock section) have six. Add the missing question, or correct change.md so the docs and the code agree.

aria-hidden depends on the motion setting: the stage is hidden from screen readers when motion is allowed and exposed when reduced motion is on. Screen-reader users get different content depending on an unrelated preference. Pick one: mark the stage aria-hidden always (it's decorative, and the steps carry the story), or always expose it.
findings.scenario: Screen reader with motion allowed → the terminal, card and audit line are never announced. Same reader with reduced motion on → all three are read.
